topups.why: Sound, but only 2 USE are needed.
Sound, but only 2 USE are needed.
'fyddwn i ddim' is conditional ('I wouldn't'), but '않을 것 같아' reads as a guess about the future, so the Korean allows more than one Welsh answer.
'yn y Gymraeg' is unnatural here; idiomatic Welsh is 'yn Gymraeg'.
